title: How many ways can a Rubik's cube be mixed up?
subtitle: Guess how many ways a Rubik's cube can be mixed up, on a scale of powers of ten, then learn why every mess is at most twenty moves from solved.
notes: TEMPLATE GAP: a log scale prints every decade's full number, unreadable over 18 decades. Workaround: draw only pos_line + pos_tick_N, hide pos_tick_N_num, add word labels (thousand…sextillion), hide pos_answer_num after the guess. Isometric cube from 27 filled paths.
